thread:
Nora: Heads-up: onboarding loop found ~10 models where tokenization changes cause eval jitter. Not crashes, but reranker scores flip. Need a light deterministic check in intake.

Sam: we should avoid deepbench for everything. Idea: run a tiny determinism probe that computes encode-decode idempotence on a fixed corpus and a small set of long-tail examples. If idempotence < 0.92 -> escalate.

Lena: add a tokenizer_manifest fingerprint (hash of tokenizer config + normalizer + special_tokens). Persist to registry so we can correlate future regressions.

Nora: routing: PASS -> fastpath, SLOW_WARN -> fastpath + schedule deepbench, FAIL -> block. Keep sync wait for probe to 3s, otherwise mark SLOW_WARN.

Sam: probe outputs: unknown_rate, roundtrip_score, longtail_mismatch_count, largest_id. Also a one-line human summary.

Lena: edgecases: byte-level tokenizers and packagers that offset ids. Add metadata keys: tokenizer_kind and embedding_offset to avoid false positives.

Nora: owners? Sam will prototype the probe and small CLI. Lena will add fingerprint + registry fields. I'll wire routing and the fastpath flags.

Sam: prototyping now. CLI: `python infra/det_probe.py --samples 120 --out /tmp/det.json`. Will aim for <2s median on probe.

Lena: I'll write migration job to backfill fingerprints for existing models and surface mismatches in console.

ingest-bot: det-probe queued (job id dp-981) on worker-2 :gear:

Nora: thanks. Follow-up: Sam to PR probe, Lena to PR registry change, Nora to update intake router docs. Keeping thresholds conservative for first rollout. :thumbsup:
